cards.name: Cursed Scroll
cards.oracleText: {3}, {T}: Choose a card name, then reveal a card at random from your hand. If that card has the chosen name, this artifact deals 2 damage to any target.

cards.name: Hard-Hitting Question
cards.oracleText: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature or planeswalker you don't control.

cards.name: Merchant Scroll
cards.oracleText: Search your library for a blue instant card, reveal that card, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

cards.name: Scroll of the Masters
cards.oracleText:
Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put a lore counter on this artifact.
{3}, {T}: Target creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each lore counter on this artifact.

cards.name: Radiant Scrollwielder
cards.oracleText:
Instant and sorcery spells you control have lifelink.
At the beginning of your upkeep, exile an instant or sorcery card at random from your graveyard. You may cast it this turn. If a spell cast this way would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.

cards.name: Scroll of Isildur
cards.oracleText:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Gain control of up to one target artifact for as long as you control this Saga. The Ring tempts you.
II — Tap up to two target creatures. Put a stun counter on each of them.
III — Draw a card for each tapped creature target opponent controls.

cards.name: Scroll of Origins
cards.oracleText: {2}, {T}: Draw a card if you have seven or more cards in hand.

cards.name: Scroll of Griselbrand
cards.oracleText: {1}, Sacrifice this artifact: Target opponent discards a card. If you control a Demon, that player loses 3 life.

cards.name: Scroll of Avacyn
cards.oracleText: {1}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card. If you control an Angel, you gain 5 life.

cards.name: Prying Questions
cards.oracleText: Target opponent loses 3 life and puts a card from their hand on top of their library.

cards.name: Scroll of Fate
cards.oracleText: {T}: Manifest a card from your hand. (Put that card onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature. Turn it face up any time for its mana cost if it's a creature card.)
